## Download

1. Download **Lucid.zip** below (under Assets).
2. Double-click it, then drag **Lucid.app** into your **Applications** folder.
3. Open Lucid. Lucid isn't notarized by Apple yet, so macOS will say it can't verify the app. Click **Done**, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway** next to Lucid, then confirm. You only do this once.

Requires an Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or newer) on macOS 14 Sonoma or later.

**Or install with one command.** Open Terminal, paste this and press Return. It downloads the latest release into Applications and clears macOS's download flag, so you can skip step 3:

```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jedbrnth-eng/lucid-live-wallpaper/main/install.sh | bash
```

Want to read it first? It's [install.sh](https://github.com/jedbrnth-eng/lucid-live-wallpaper/blob/main/install.sh), about 40 lines.
